### bot/config.py
```python
"""FishID Bot — конфигурация."""
import os
from dataclasses import dataclass

@dataclass
class Config:
    bot_token: str
    gemini_api_key: str
    database_url: str
    admin_id: int
    fishbot_url: str = "https://t.me/fishinglogs_bot"
    max_photo_size_mb: int = 10
    rate_limit_per_user: int = 10     # идентификаций в день (free)
    rate_limit_pro_user: int = 100    # pro пользователи
    debug: bool = False

def load_config() -> Config:
    return Config(
        bot_token=os.environ["FISHID_BOT_TOKEN"],
        gemini_api_key=os.environ["GEMINI_API_KEY"],
        database_url=os.environ.get(
            "DATABASE_URL",
            "postgresql://<USER>:<PASS>@<HOST>/<DB>"
        ),
        admin_id=int(os.environ.get("ADMIN_ID", "<ADMIN_ID>")),
        debug=os.environ.get("DEBUG", "").lower() == "true",
    )

```
